ranger.name: Ranger
ranger.desc: Cheap and reliable. Shoots piercing arrows at one target.

tiers.name: Sharp Tips
tiers.desc: Arrows pierce 1 more enemy.

tiers.name: Hunter's Arrows
tiers.desc: Arrows pierce 2 more enemies.

tiers.name: Triple Shot
tiers.desc: Fires 3 arrows in a fan.

tiers.name: Arrowstorm
tiers.desc: Fires 5 arrows. +1 damage, pierces 2 more.

tiers.name: Sky Splitter
tiers.desc: Seven giant magic arrows. They pierce Ironshell.

tiers.name: Quick Draw
tiers.desc: Shoots faster.

tiers.name: Quicker Draw
tiers.desc: Shoots even faster.

tiers.name: Repeater
tiers.desc: Repeating mechanism: much faster, faster arrows.

tiers.name: Volley Captain
tiers.desc: Faster still. Ability: Arrow Rain - all Rangers shoot 3x as fast for 6 s.

tiers.name: Thousand Arrows
tiers.desc: A blur of arrows: 12 shots a second. Arrow Rain lasts 8 s.

tiers.name: Longbow
tiers.desc: Range +25%.

tiers.name: Eagle Eye
tiers.desc: Spots camouflaged Glims. Range +10%.

tiers.name: Ballista
tiers.desc: A ballista bolt: 3 damage, pierces 5, magic. Slower, longer range.

tiers.name: Siege Ballista
tiers.desc: Heavy bolts: 7 damage, pierces 10. +4 vs Brutes, +12 vs the Leviathan.

tiers.name: Starfall Ballista
tiers.desc: Bolts hit for 18, pierce 30, +30 vs the Leviathan. Burst in a starry blast at the last hit.

bombardier.name: Bombardier
bombardier.desc: Lobs bombs that burst in an area. Cracks armor.

tiers.name: Bigger Bombs
tiers.desc: Blast radius +30%, hits 8 more enemies.

tiers.name: Heavy Shells
tiers.desc: +1 damage.

tiers.name: Shellcracker
tiers.desc: +4 damage vs Brutes and the Leviathan.

tiers.name: Siege Mortar
tiers.desc: +3 damage, bigger blast, fires faster.

tiers.name: Doomsday Keg
tiers.desc: +10 damage, huge blast, +40 vs the Leviathan.

tiers.name: Quick Fuse
tiers.desc: Fires faster.

tiers.name: Long Barrel
tiers.desc: Range +20%, bombs fly faster.

tiers.name: Cluster Bombs
tiers.desc: Each blast throws 6 sharp splinters.

tiers.name: Clusterstorm
tiers.desc: 8 splinters, each one bursts in a tiny blast.

tiers.name: Bombardment
tiers.desc: Fires 2.5x as fast and throws 12 splinters.

tiers.name: Wide Range
tiers.desc: Range +15%.

tiers.name: Ringing Blast
tiers.desc: Stuns hit enemies for 0.3 s (not the Leviathan).

tiers.name: Concussion Shells
tiers.desc: Stuns for 1 s (0.2 s on the Leviathan).

tiers.name: Thunder Cannon
tiers.desc: Stuns for 1.5 s (0.5 s Leviathan). Bigger blast, +2 damage.

tiers.name: Earthshaker
tiers.desc: Every 3rd shot is a quake: everything in range takes 5 and is stunned for 2 s (1 s Leviathan).

frostcaller.name: Frostcaller
frostcaller.desc: Controls the lane. Slows, freezes and shocks.

tiers.name: Chill
tiers.desc: Bolts slow by 45% for 2 s.

tiers.name: Frost Aura
tiers.desc: Aura: every Glim in range is 25% slower (not the Leviathan).

tiers.name: Blizzard
tiers.desc: Aura slows 50% and deals 1 damage every 1.5 s to up to 20 enemies.

tiers.name: Glacier Heart
tiers.desc: Aura slows 60%, and the Leviathan by 25%.

tiers.name: Absolute Zero
tiers.desc: Aura damage 2. Ability: Absolute Zero freezes everything for 4 s (Leviathan 1.5 s).

tiers.name: Frost Nova
tiers.desc: Bolts burst on the first hit, freezing up to 6 nearby enemies.

tiers.name: Brittle Ice
tiers.desc: Slowed enemies take +1 damage from every source.

tiers.name: Ice Shards
tiers.desc: Each nova throws 5 sharp ice shards.

tiers.name: Glacial Spike
tiers.desc: Fires faster. +3 damage, +6 vs the Leviathan.

tiers.name: Winter's Wrath
tiers.desc: +8 damage, 12 shards, nova radius x1.25.

tiers.name: Spark
tiers.desc: Hits arc as lightning to 2 more enemies.

tiers.name: Storm Sight
tiers.desc: Spots camouflaged Glims. Range +15%.

tiers.name: Chain Lightning
tiers.desc: Main attack becomes instant chain lightning: 6 targets, 2 damage.

tiers.name: Tempest
tiers.desc: Chain of 10, 3 damage, fires much faster.

tiers.name: Stormcaller
tiers.desc: Chain of 18, 6 damage. Every 4 s a thunderclap smites the strongest enemy for 60.

longshot.name: Longshot
longshot.desc: Sniper with a range of the whole map. Slow, hard-hitting shots that arrive almost instantly.

tiers.name: Iron Bolt
tiers.desc: Iron-tipped bolt: 4 damage, magic (cracks Ironshell).

tiers.name: Piercing Bolt
tiers.desc: Longer barrel: 7 damage, pierces 2.

tiers.name: Deadeye
tiers.desc: 18 damage, +10 against Brutes.

tiers.name: Giantslayer
tiers.desc: 30 damage, +100 against bosses.

tiers.name: Lanternbreaker
tiers.desc: 80 damage, +500 against bosses. A hit staggers a boss for 0.5 s.

tiers.name: Night Scope
tiers.desc: Green night-vision glass: detects Shades (camo).

tiers.name: Quick Reload
tiers.desc: Shoots 30% faster.

tiers.name: Repeater
tiers.desc: Repeating rifle: shoots three times as fast.

tiers.name: Volley Squad
tiers.desc: A second shooter. Ability Focus: all Longshots shoot twice as fast for 8 s. Cooldown 60 s.

tiers.name: Lantern Legion
tiers.desc: Three shooters: fires every 0.12 s, 4 damage.

tiers.name: Shrapnel
tiers.desc: A hit throws 3 splinters.

tiers.name: Ricochet
tiers.desc: The bolt jumps to 2 more enemies, 1 damage less each time.

tiers.name: Supply Drop
tiers.desc: Ability Supply Drop: a crate with +800 gold. Cooldown 60 s.

tiers.name: Elite Sniper
tiers.desc: All Longshots shoot 40% faster. Strong targeting prefers Brutes.

tiers.name: Crippling Shot
tiers.desc: Hits slow normal enemies by 50% for 2 s. Bosses take 20% more damage from every source for 3 s.

market.name: Lantern Market
market.desc: No attack. Pays gold at the end of every round, banks interest, or lights up the towers around it.

tiers.name: Busy Stalls
tiers.desc: A second stall: +30 gold each round.

tiers.name: Night Market
tiers.desc: Lantern string lights up: +40 gold each round.

tiers.name: Trade Hall
tiers.desc: Half-timbered hall: 320 gold each round.

tiers.name: Merchant Guild
tiers.desc: Guild house: 900 gold each round.

tiers.name: Golden Exchange
tiers.desc: Golden dome: 2,400 gold each round. Other Markets earn 10% more.

tiers.name: Coin Purse
tiers.desc: +20 gold each round.

tiers.name: Lockbox
tiers.desc: Income goes into a bank (Withdraw). 10% interest per round, holds up to 3,000.

tiers.name: Lantern Bank
tiers.desc: 15% interest per round, holds up to 7,000.

tiers.name: Grant Office
tiers.desc: Ability Grant: +2,000 gold. Cooldown 90 s.

tiers.name: Treasury
tiers.desc: Grant gives +8,000 gold. 20% interest, holds up to 20,000.

tiers.name: Watchpost
tiers.desc: Towers nearby see 10% farther.

tiers.name: Lookout Bell
tiers.desc: Towers nearby detect Shades (camo).

tiers.name: Drum Hall
tiers.desc: Towers nearby attack 15% faster.

tiers.name: Armory
tiers.desc: Towers nearby: sharp shots crack Ironshell, +1 pierce.

tiers.name: Lantern Capital
tiers.desc: Towers nearby: +1 damage, upgrades cost 10% less.

thornweaver.name: Thornweaver
thornweaver.desc: Nature caster. Throws a fan of thorns at close range; grows into lightning, vines and a whole forest.

tiers.name: Hard Thorns
tiers.desc: Thorns pierce 2 enemies.

tiers.name: Heart of Thunder
tiers.desc: Every 2.3 s a chain lightning hits 4 targets for 2 damage.

tiers.name: Tempest
tiers.desc: Lightning hits 8 targets for 3. Every 4 s a whirlwind throws Glims 40 px back along the path (not bosses).

tiers.name: Storm Mother
tiers.desc: Lightning hits 15 targets for 6 damage.

tiers.name: Avatar of Wrath
tiers.desc: +1 damage for every 25 enemies on the map (up to +10).

tiers.name: Thorn Burst
tiers.desc: Throws 8 thorns in all directions instead of a fan.

tiers.name: Vine Snare
tiers.desc: Every 3 s a vine holds a Glim in place for 1.5 s (not bosses).

tiers.name: Wall of Trees
tiers.desc: Ability: a wall of trees grows on the path and swallows 150 RBE of Glims (not bosses). Cooldown 45 s.

tiers.name: Spirit of the Forest
tiers.desc: Thorny vines cover the path in range: 1 damage per second to everything inside.

tiers.name: World Tree
tiers.desc: Vine damage 5 per second over twice the radius. +100 gold each round.

tiers.name: Druidic Reach
tiers.desc: Range +15%.

tiers.name: Herbal Lore
tiers.desc: Detects Shades (camo).

tiers.name: Jungle's Bounty
tiers.desc: +150 gold and +2 lives each round.

tiers.name: Spring Blessing
tiers.desc: Towers in range attack 15% faster.

tiers.name: Grove Guardian
tiers.desc: Thorns turn to magic (crack Ironshell) and deal +3 damage.

alchemist.name: Alchemist
alchemist.desc: Lobs acid potions, brews buffs for nearby towers and turns gold out of lead.

tiers.name: Larger Potions
tiers.desc: Splash radius +30%.

tiers.name: Acidic Mixture
tiers.desc: +1 damage against Ironshell and Brutes. Acid 2 per second.

tiers.name: Berserker Brew
tiers.desc: Every 6 s a potion on a tower in range: +1 damage, +15% range, +10% speed for 8 s.

tiers.name: Stronger Stimulant
tiers.desc: Potion gives +2 damage and +25% speed.

tiers.name: Permanent Brew
tiers.desc: The potion effect lasts for good on every tower in range.

tiers.name: Stronger Acid
tiers.desc: Acid 3 per second.

tiers.name: Perishing Potions
tiers.desc: +2 damage against Brutes, +5 against bosses.

tiers.name: Unstable Concoction
tiers.desc: Hit Glims explode when they die: radius 24 px, 4 damage.

tiers.name: Transforming Tonic
tiers.desc: Ability: becomes a monster for 20 s, 30 damage per second to the strongest target. Cooldown 60 s.

tiers.name: Total Transformation
tiers.desc: The ability also transforms 5 towers in range.

tiers.name: Faster Throwing
tiers.desc: Throws 25% faster.

tiers.name: Acid Pool
tiers.desc: Potions leave acid pools on the path: 1 damage every 0.5 s, 20 hits.

tiers.name: Lead to Gold
tiers.desc: Every Ironshell it cracks pays +40 gold.

tiers.name: Rubber to Gold
tiers.desc: Hit Glims pay +1 gold per layer for 30 s.

tiers.name: Shrink Potion
tiers.desc: Every 3 s the strongest Glim in range (not bosses) shrinks to a Red Glim.

riverkeeper.name: Riverkeeper
riverkeeper.desc: Water tower. Harpoons, sonar and a lantern ship. Can only be built on water.

tiers.name: Barbed Harpoons
tiers.desc: Harpoons pierce 2 more enemies.

tiers.name: Harpoon Volley
tiers.desc: Fires 3 harpoons in a fan.

tiers.name: Tidal Steel
tiers.desc: Steel tips hit Ironshell. +2 damage, +4 against Brutes and ships.

tiers.name: Whaler
tiers.desc: +3 damage, +10 against Brutes and ships, +10 against bosses.

tiers.name: Tidal Lance
tiers.desc: One huge lance: 40 damage, pierces 25. +40 against Brutes and ships, +200 against bosses.

tiers.name: Sonar Ping
tiers.desc: Detects camouflage. Range +10%.

tiers.name: Sonar Array
tiers.desc: Towers within 80 px detect camouflage.

tiers.name: Riptide
tiers.desc: Enemies in range move 30% slower (bosses 15%, ships 15%).

tiers.name: Deep Current
tiers.desc: Slow 45% (bosses 20%). Towers within 80 px get +15% range.

tiers.name: Leviathan Call
tiers.desc: Every 4 s the Leviathan strikes the strongest enemy in range for 150 damage. Slow 55%.

tiers.name: Deck Gun
tiers.desc: Attacks 20% faster.

tiers.name: Lantern Ship
tiers.desc: Cannonballs: 3 damage, pierce 4, burst on the last hit (18 px, 2 damage).

tiers.name: Broadside
tiers.desc: Fires 4 cannonballs at once. Bursts 22 px.

tiers.name: Man o' War
tiers.desc: +3 damage, attacks 20% faster. Bursts 26 px for 5 damage. +6 against Brutes and ships.

tiers.name: Dusk Armada
tiers.desc: A whole fleet: 8 cannonballs per volley, bursts 30 px for 10 damage. +10 against Brutes and ships, +20 against bosses.

bellringer.name: Bellringer
bellringer.desc: Does not attack. Its bells buff every tower within 80 px: speed, sight, cheaper upgrades, or a toll of gold.

tiers.name: Swift Chime
tiers.desc: Towers in range attack 10% faster.

tiers.name: Resonant Bronze
tiers.desc: Towers in range attack 18% faster. Radius +15%.

tiers.name: Grand Peal
tiers.desc: Attack speed +25%. Towers in range pierce 1 more enemy.

tiers.name: Cathedral Bells
tiers.desc: Attack speed +35%, +1 damage for towers in range.

tiers.name: Grand Carillon
tiers.desc: Attack speed +50%, +2 damage, pierce +2 for towers in range. Radius +40%.

tiers.name: Watch Bell
tiers.desc: Towers in range detect camouflage.

tiers.name: Haggler's Bell
tiers.desc: Upgrades for towers in range cost 8% less. Radius +10%.

tiers.name: Alarm
tiers.desc: Ability: every enemy stops for 2 s (bosses 1 s). Cooldown 60 s.

tiers.name: Town Crier
tiers.desc: Upgrades cost 15% less. Alarm lasts 3 s (bosses 1.5 s), cooldown 50 s.

tiers.name: Dusk Siren
tiers.desc: Alarm lasts 4 s (bosses 2 s), cooldown 40 s; alarmed enemies take +1 damage for 4 s. Upgrades cost 20% less. Sharp hits crack Ironshell.

tiers.name: Toll of Coin
tiers.desc: +30 gold at the end of every round.

tiers.name: Silver Bell
tiers.desc: +80 gold per round.

tiers.name: Merchants' Peal
tiers.desc: +220 gold per round.

tiers.name: Bell Foundry
tiers.desc: +520 gold per round. Upgrades for towers in range cost 5% less.

tiers.name: Golden Belfry
tiers.desc: +1,400 gold per round. Upgrades for towers in range cost 10% less.

tinker.name: Tinker
tinker.desc: Builds things. Nail gun at the start; sentries, caltrops on the road and Overclock come with upgrades.

tiers.name: Sentry Kit
tiers.desc: Builds a sentry every 7 s (one at a time, 25 s each). It shoots nails.

tiers.name: Twin Sentries
tiers.desc: Two sentries at once, built every 6 s, shooting faster.

tiers.name: Sentry Guns
tiers.desc: Three sentries, 2 damage, pierce 3, magic nails (hit Ironshell).

tiers.name: Clockwork Turrets
tiers.desc: Four sentries, 3 damage, fast. +3 against Brutes and ships.

tiers.name: Clockwork Fort
tiers.desc: Five sentries, 3 damage, pierce 3, a shot every 0.25 s, 45 s each. +8 against Brutes and ships, +10 against bosses.

tiers.name: Caltrop Layer
tiers.desc: Lays caltrops on the road in range every 8 s (3 at a time): each pops 6 layers.

tiers.name: Spiked Caltrops
tiers.desc: Caltrops hold 10 hits and deal 2 damage. Laid every 7 s.

tiers.name: Spike Mat
tiers.desc: Five mats at once, 14 hits each, 3 damage, laid every 6 s.

tiers.name: Heavy Spikes
tiers.desc: Six mats, 20 hits each, 5 damage, laid every 5 s.

tiers.name: Iron Thorn Field
tiers.desc: Ten mats at once, 30 hits each, 8 damage, laid every 2.5 s.

tiers.name: Oiled Gears
tiers.desc: Attacks 15% faster.

tiers.name: Gear Sight
tiers.desc: Detects camouflage. Range +15%.

tiers.name: Overclock
tiers.desc: Ability: the 4 nearest towers in range attack twice as fast for 10 s. Cooldown 50 s.

tiers.name: Overclock Lab
tiers.desc: Overclock reaches 8 towers, lasts 12 s, cooldown 40 s.

tiers.name: Ultra-Overclock
tiers.desc: Overclock reaches 20 towers, lasts 15 s, cooldown 35 s. Towers within 70 px always attack 10% faster.

wren.name: Wren
wren.title: the Lamplighter
wren.desc: Hero. One per match. Gains XP after every round and levels up to 20.

levels.desc: Ability: Flare - a light orb on the strongest target: 5 damage in a wide area and reveals camouflage for good.
Bolts set enemies ablaze: 1 damage per second for 3 s.
Ability: Dawnbreak - a beam of light across the whole path: 12 damage to every enemy, 100 to the Leviathan.
Aura: towers within 84 px shoot 10% faster.
Dawnbreak: 36 damage (240 to the Leviathan), cooldown 45 s.

bram.name: Bram
bram.title: Ironwright
bram.desc: Hero. A smith who throws hammers that crack armor. Builds a forge, drops an anvil, ends with the Forge of Dawn.

levels.desc: Hammer throws: 2 damage, pierces 2, magic. +2 against Brutes and Ironshell.
The Forge: towers within 80 px deal +1 damage.
Forge bellows: towers within the forge attack 10% faster.
Ability: Anvil Drop - an anvil crushes the strongest target: 30 damage (150 to bosses) in 30 px, stuns 2 s. Cooldown 55 s.
Anvil Drop: 60 damage (400 to bosses), cooldown 45 s.
Ability: Forge of Dawn - for 10 s every tower breaks armor (sharp hits crack Ironshell, +3 damage against armored foes). Cooldown 80 s. Anvil Drop: 100 damage (800 to bosses).

sela.name: Sela
sela.title: Nightglass
sela.desc: Hero. A seer with a long-range starlight rifle. Sees camouflage, lends her sight to nearby towers, calls down Starfall and ends with Eclipse.

levels.desc: Starlight shots: 3 damage, pierces 1, magic, long range. Sees camouflage.
Nightglass sight: towers within 80 px detect camouflage.
Ability: Starfall - a beam of starlight along the road in her range: 20 damage to every foe (120 to bosses). Cooldown 50 s.
Towers within her sight get +10% range.
Starfall: 40 damage (300 to bosses), cooldown 40 s.
Ability: Eclipse - for 4 s every foe moves at half speed, ships and bosses too. Cooldown 70 s. Starfall: 70 damage (600 to bosses).
